description:
Each check runs inside a copy-on-write filesystem sandbox so an agent can read/modify the tree freely without corrupting the real working directory. Define a boxed `#[async_trait] Sandbox: Send + Sync` trait (mirroring `BoxedIngress` etc.) plus `cfg`-gated platform selection. The macOS implementation is a separate ticket.
